title: two_zone_mode 'auto' forces two zones, so a single-zone install's options flow hides its whole-house heat loss
claim: For an entry with no zone key, with two_zone_mode absent or 'auto' (2 of 2 single-zone entries), ThermalParameters.from_config reports two_zone_enabled=True and the options flow's thermal_model page does not render house_heat_loss_coefficient. The questionnaire also derives zone masses for a single-storey answer set. So the UI cannot configure the parameter the single-zone model reads, a config-flow (Bronze) failure (D10-criteria Q2). Null controls: two_zone_mode 'off' renders the field (1), and zone keys present hide it by design (1).
mechanism: ThermalParameters.from_config tests `two_zone_mode in (const.TWO_ZONE_MODE_ON, const.DEFAULT_TWO_ZONE_MODE)`. DEFAULT_TWO_ZONE_MODE is 'auto', so 'auto' and every entry without the key take the forced-on branch, never the presence rule the function's own comment says 'auto' keeps. config_flow._single_zone, which gates the _OPTION_FIELDS row for house_heat_loss_coefficient (when=_single_zone), and presets.preset_from_config both read this predicate. The same predicate selects the model the solver runs; that consequence is outside this cell and is passed on as a lead.

evidence.unit: single-zone entries (of 2) whose thermal_model options page hides house_heat_loss_coefficient
evidence.machine: macOS arm64 8-core (box B1, local), venv-ci Python 3.14.7
evidence.contention_note: box shared with other finder seats and this seat's coverage run; the count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: from_config recompiled in memory with the mode test `two_zone_mode == const.TWO_ZONE_MODE_ON` (the one-line fix)

metric_definition: Count of entries with no zone key and mode absent/auto whose options-flow thermal_model data_schema lacks house_heat_loss_coefficient.
phenomenon_property: Each options page offers every field the model in force reads. A single-zone install (no zone key, mode auto or absent) resolves single-zone and is offered its whole-house heat loss.

null_control.command: same harness, mode_off and zone_keys arms
null_control.note: the page logic itself is correct when the predicate is. Under the perturbation the questionnaire arm derives no zone keys and joins the single-zone count (3 of 3 rendered).

reproduction_steps: Create an entry with the Tibber token and weather entity only (Finish setup now)
Options > Thermal model: the 'House heat loss' field is absent, and the entry runs the two-zone model
proposed_fix_scope: thermal_model.py ThermalParameters.from_config: make 'auto' apply the presence rule (test == TWO_ZONE_MODE_ON only). Add a regression check that an entry without zone keys resolves single-zone and its thermal_model page renders the field. This is the same predicate tests/config_flow_steps.py's failing questionnaire and field-registry checks exercise.
